text: What happened on 16 May 1976? Maulana Abdul Hamid Khan Bhashani led a mass long march from Rajshahi toward the Farakka frontier over Ganges-water rights.
Why did the Farakka Long March matter? It transformed river-water sharing from a technical dispute into a mass political issue in Bangladesh.
The 1976 march made ecological risk and sovereignty politics converge in public memory.
